rows: Why is leading-edge fab so concentrated in Taiwan?
Decades of compound investment (TSMC), network of local suppliers, government support — not easily replicated
A marketing label — physical gate ≈10 nm; "nm" refers to density/architecture benchmark, not a dimension
Why did CPU clock speeds plateau ~2005?
Dennard scaling broke (leakage → heat); power wall hit; industry pivoted to multi-core
Advanced packaging (CoWoS, 3D) partly substitutes for atomic-scale fab improvements
Variability (quantum tunneling through gate), interconnect RC delay, heat density, lithography resolution
